name: core
doc: solid-watch core node types. Layout props use React Native / Yoga names and React Native defaults. A prop's `kind` tells the host what a change invalidates: layout (Yoga style), measure (re-measure a leaf: dirty its Yoga node), paint (redraw only), behavior (host behaviour, no layout), event (a JS handler: the host only learns whether one is set). `version` is the contract version (README: Contract version): hosts expose it as `__host.version`, bundles read it with `hostVersion()`.

font.doc: The one font both hosts measure and draw with (fonts/, SIL OFL 1.1). Its hhea, typo and win metrics agree (ascent 2728, descent 680, gap 0, 2816 units/em), so the default line height is fontSize x 3408/2816 everywhere. fontWeight drives the wght axis (100-900).

layout.doc: Yoga style. Defaults are Yoga's own (non-web) defaults, which are React Native's.

overflow.doc: hidden also clips children when drawing.

box.doc: Paint for any visible node. None of it changes layout: frames are Yoga's.

borderRadius.doc: Points, continuous corners. A radius past half the shorter side is drawn as half of it: 999 makes a capsule (or a circle of a square).

rotate.doc: Degrees clockwise about the node's centre, drawing only (CSS `rotate`): the frame and the layout around it are unrotated.

scale.doc: Drawn scale about the node's centre, drawing only (CSS `scale`).

textStyle.doc: Text style. Inherited: a nested <text> (a span) takes its parent's value unless it sets its own.

fontWeight.doc: normal = 400, bold = 700; drawn on the font's wght axis.

lineHeight.doc: Points; null = fontSize x the font's line-height ratio.

letterSpacing.doc: Points added after every character (CSS letter-spacing, Core Text kern), scaled with the text by minScale.

textLayout.doc: Measurement of a text leaf (the outermost <text>). Ignored on spans.

numberOfLines.doc: 0 = no limit. Lines past the limit are cut with a tail ellipsis.

minScale.doc: < 1 makes the text single-line and shrinks it to fit its width, down to fontSize x minScale (README: Shrink-to-fit).

text.doc: Text. Raw strings are only valid inside <text>. A <text> inside a <text> is a span: it styles a run of the outer text and has no layout of its own.

scroll.doc: Vertical scroll container (Digital Crown on the watch, unless a <crown> is attached). The host always gives its Yoga node overflow: scroll (its `overflow` prop is ignored), so children are not shrunk to its height. Content height = the largest child bottom edge (frame y + height + marginBottom) plus paddingBottom + borderWidth; it scrolls when that exceeds its own height. It clips.

showsVerticalScrollIndicator.doc: Show the system scroll indicator while scrolling (React Native's name; its default is true, the watch's is false).

button.doc: Tappable box. On a tap the host dispatches `press` to JS if `onPress` is set. While pressed its content is drawn at pressedOpacity, the whole button at pressedScale and on pressedBackground; a disabled button's content at opacity x 0.35 (README: Behaviour).

onPress.doc: JS handler, called with no payload (null).

onLongPress.doc: JS handler, called with no payload (null) once the button has been held for 0.5 s; the release that ends that hold does not press.

onPressIn.doc: JS handler, called with no payload (null) when a touch goes down on the button (not disabled). Every pressIn is followed by exactly one pressOut.

onPressOut.doc: JS handler, called with no payload (null) when the touch that pressed the button ends: lifted, slid off, cancelled (a scroll took it, the system took the touch), the button disabled, or the button gone from the screen (README: Behaviour).

pressedOpacity.doc: Opacity of the content while pressed (1 = no dimming).

pressedScale.doc: Drawn scale of the whole button while pressed, e.g. 0.95.

toggle.doc: An on/off switch, controlled: it draws `value` and a tap dispatches `change` with !value (if onChange is set and it is not disabled); the app sets value. A leaf, 40 x 24 unless sized: a capsule track (activeTrackColor or inactiveTrackColor) and a round knob (thumbColor), its diameter the content height - 4. Not tappable without onChange, so it can sit inside a <button> whose press flips the value.

onChange.doc: JS handler, called with the new value (a boolean).

disabled.doc: Ignores taps; drawn at opacity x 0.35.

progress.doc: A progress bar, ring or open arc filled to `value` (0..1, clamped), drawn in its content box behind its children (a ring's label goes inside it). bar: a capsule filling the content box, filled from the left (from the bottom when taller than wide). ring: a circle in the largest centred square, filled clockwise from 12 o'clock. arc: 270 degrees of that circle, open at the bottom, filled clockwise from its lower left end. Ring and arc are stroked `thickness` points wide inside the square, with round ends. No natural size: give it a size (or stretch it).

thickness.doc: ring and arc: stroke width in points.

icon.doc: An SF Symbol by name, drawn at `size` points (a font size, as text) centred in its content box, unclipped. A leaf whose natural size is size x size. The browser host has no SF Symbols: it lays the icon out the same and draws a placeholder.

name.doc: SF Symbol name, e.g. wind or heart.fill; null (or a name the watch lacks) draws nothing.

size.doc: Point size of the symbol's font.

renderingMode.doc: monochrome: all in color; hierarchical: color with lighter secondary layers; multicolor: the symbol's own colours.

image.doc: A PNG or JPEG image from a data URL (data:image/png;base64,... or data:image/jpeg;base64,...: what an image import gives a bundle), drawn into its content box and clipped to it. No natural size: give it width and height (or one and aspectRatio). Anything else (SVG, GIF, a URL) draws nothing.

resizeMode.doc: React Native's: cover fills the box (cropping), contain fits inside it, stretch fills it unevenly, center is contain without enlarging; an image's own size is its pixel size / 2 points.

tintColor.doc: Draw the image's alpha as a mask in this colour (a template image); null = its own colours.

haptic.doc: Non-visual: plays `pattern` at each commit where `trigger` differs from its value at the previous commit. The value it is created with does not play; null never plays. No layout.

crown.doc: Non-visual: binds the Digital Crown (the browser host: the mouse wheel over the screen) to a number, controlled: turning it dispatches `change` with the new value (snapped to increment, kept in min..max or wrapped) whenever that differs from the last one sent; the app sets value. While one is attached the crown drives it, not scroll views; with several, the last in tree order. No layout.

increment.doc: Values are min (or 0) + a multiple of increment, with a detent click each; null = continuous.

wrap.doc: With min and max: past max comes min again (a heading 0..360). Values are then in min..max, max excluded.

sensitivity.doc: How far a turn moves the value (watchOS DigitalCrownRotationalSensitivity).

onChange.doc: JS handler, called with the new value (a number).
